metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they loved Frozen II, they will adore the original magical musical adventure of Elsa and Anna.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An amazing fantasy adventure filled with humor and heartwarming moments, similar to Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful Pixar film about friendship and sea monsters, matching the feel of Moana and Ponyo.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: They enjoyed Inside Out 2, so seeing where Riley's emotions started in the original is a must.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A heartwarming family comedy with an incredibly lovable bear, perfect for fans of Matilda.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: An action-packed, funny superhero movie that fits perfectly with the Spider-Verse films they enjoyed.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A beautiful, touching, and funny adventure story with great characters, much like Toy Story.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A very creative and funny journey through video game worlds, perfect for fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious spin on superhero tropes with great comedy and a redemptive story arc like Despicable Me.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: More minion chaos and family-focused laughs following up on the original movie they liked.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed Disney adventure featuring the lovable robot Baymax, perfect for fans of Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: Incredibly funny and fast-paced adventure featuring beloved toys, matching the energy of Toy Story and Mario.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: A fun, colorful prequel showing how Mike and Sulley became friends, perfect for fans of Monsters, Inc.

metas.name: Klaus
metas.description: A beautifully animated, heartwarming origin story of Santa Claus that matches the cozy festive vibe of The Grinch.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually gorgeous Pixar story about different elements living together, similar in vibe to Zootopia and Inside Out.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A funny and exciting prehistoric road-trip adventure perfect for fans of Ice Age.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: The fun continues with Po reuniting with his family, ideal for fans of the first two Kung Fu Panda movies.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A very funny, spooky-but-cute comedy with lovable monsters, matching the fun energy of Shrek.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A highly imaginative and hilarious comedy about food falling from the sky.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A delightfully charming and funny story about a polite bear exploring London, ideal for family viewing.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A brilliant, dialogue-free slapstick comedy that fans of Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit will love.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: The highly-anticipated sequel that continues the hilarious, high-stakes adventures of Ginger and Rocky.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A touching and magical journey across breathtaking landscapes to return a friendly Yeti home.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical fantasy quest involving two brothers, perfect for fans of Castle in the Sky and Brave.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A fast-paced, funny look at what pets do when their owners leave, ideal for fans of Toy Story.

metas.name: Vivo
metas.description: A vibrant musical adventure with catchy songs by Lin-Manuel Miranda, similar to Moana and Encanto.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A beautifully animated musical adventure based on Chinese mythology, great for fans of Coco.

metas.name: Peter Rabbit
metas.description: A fun live-action/animated hybrid comedy about mischievous animals, appealing to fans of Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: Soul
metas.description: A visually stunning and deeply moving Pixar movie about music and finding your spark, perfect after Inside Out.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A heartwarming Disney adventure about a heroic dog who thinks he actually has superpowers.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A hilarious adventure about zoo animals lost in the wild, matching the comedic tone of Ice Age and Rio.

metas.name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
metas.description: Continues the laugh-out-loud adventures of Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria in the African savanna.

metas.name: Shrek Forever After
metas.description: A fun alternate-universe adventure that wraps up the Shrek story, perfect for fans of the series.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: An epic, emotionally resonant sequel with spectacular dragon-flying action.

metas.name: Rise of the Guardians
metas.description: A visually stunning fantasy action film where beloved childhood legends team up to protect hope and imagination.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: An incredibly silly and funny spin-off focusing on the hilarious yellow henchmen they loved in Despicable Me.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Gru meets his long-lost twin brother in this action-comedy sequel full of 80s pop culture references.

metas.name: Ice Age: The Meltdown
metas.description: The sub-zero heroes return for a fun, water-filled adventure, perfect for fans of the first Ice Age.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A highly clever, warm-hearted, and fast-paced Christmas movie from Aardman Animations.
